utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: Watch the road. Watch the road.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Is not— is not going to yelling at us?

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: I don't know. First driving lesson you got. Pay attention. What would you do if a car came?

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: I'll stop. I think the sensor is beeping, should I—

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: Say, 'Papa, take over fast, here comes a car.' No? Or are you going to drive it anyway? Stop worrying about the bells and whistles and look at the asphalt.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: No... you're being totally mid right now, just let me drive.

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: Mid? What is a mid? Speak English and swipe the road!
